//: WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Every SQL call in this repo was prompting the founder for approval, dozens per session, because the Supabase allowlist lived only in ottoyarddepot-sim/.claude/settings.json and this repo had no .claude/ directory at all. 'Accept all edits' does not help: acceptEdits auto-approves FILE EDITS, not MCP tool calls. Two mechanisms below, deliberately both: the allow list covers the canonical server name, and the PreToolUse hook covers the case where the MCP server is registered under a generated UUID instead (which is why the sibling repo carries a second copy of every entry under mcp__821b36d8-...). The hook matches on the tool SUFFIX so it works under any server name, present or future.

permissions.//deny: NOT auto-approved, on purpose: create_project, delete_branch, pause_project and restore_project are account-level and destructive. They stay behind a prompt. Nothing in this build track needs them.

hooks.command: jq -c "if (.tool_name | test(\"^mcp__.*__(execute_sql|apply_migration|query_logs|list_tables|list_projects|list_branches|list_migrations|list_extensions|list_edge_functions|get_edge_function|deploy_edge_function|list_organizations|get_organization|get_project|get_project_url|get_publishable_keys|get_advisors|get_cost|confirm_cost|search_docs|generate_typescript_types|create_branch|merge_branch|rebase_branch|reset_branch)$\")) then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PreToolUse\",permissionDecision:\"allow\",permissionDecisionReason:\"Supabase MCP auto-approved by otto-q-core project policy — see .claude/settings.json\"}} else {} end" 2>/dev/null || true
